common.tagline: No one should have to go alone.

welcome.title: Someone nearby can be there.
welcome.line1: Teman connects people who need someone beside them with neighbours who have a few hours to give. Always free.
welcome.line2: You say what you need, or when you are free. Someone nearby answers.
welcome.line3: Verified neighbours, no payments, no ratings — just company.

verify.whyTitle: Why we ask for your ID
verify.whyFor: People decide to meet a stranger based on trust. A checked ID is the biggest part of that trust.
verify.whyWhoSees: One trained reviewer at our partner organisation sees it. Other members never do.
verify.whyRetention: After review, your photos are deleted within 90 days. We never keep your IC number — only a scrambled code used to spot duplicates.
verify.docPassportSub: If you are not a Malaysian citizen
verify.docNumberHint: Used only to spot the same document on two accounts. Never stored as-is.
verify.idGuide: All four corners visible, no glare. A photo you already have in your gallery is fine.
verify.idPromise: Reviewed by a person. Deleted after 90 days. Never shown to other members.
verify.selfieWhy: This confirms the account belongs to the person on the document. It is compared once by the reviewer, then deleted with the rest.
verify.submitFailed: That did not go through. Everything you entered is still here — try again.
verify.pendingWho: A coordinator at our partner organisation checks your photos against your name.
verify.pendingHowLong: Usually the same day during recruitment drives. We will tell you the moment it is decided.
verify.rejectedTitle: Your ID could not be accepted
verify.rejectedNoReason: No reason was recorded. Please try again.
verify.rejectedNext: This is fixable — most rejections are a blurry corner or a cut-off edge.
verify.rejectedHuman: If you believe this is wrong, tell the coordinator at your orientation session — a person will look at it with you.
